'''''Pelex''''' was a group of three [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transports]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The transports attempted to destroy the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Lightning (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Lightning'']] that attacked a small group of [[Class-A cargo container|cargo containers]] [[Koss (Class-A cargo container)|''Koss'']]. The transports were destroyed by a single [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptor]]. The event was recorded for the [[Combat chamber]] to train future pilots such as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
